description: Supplemental municipal-published Environics 2022 estimates. These values are not 2021 Census counts and must not be used as denominators for 2021 visible-minority counts. No income median is present.
license: No separate licence statement in ArcGIS item or layer metadata; the public City of Brampton service contains third-party Environics estimates. Do not assume Statistics Canada Open Licence covers these estimates.
idField: OBJECTID of current brampton-neighbourhoods.geojson, joined to source by NEIGHBOURHOOD_NAME

boundaryMatch.method: Each source/current polygon repaired using Shapely make_valid, projected to EPSG:26917; symmetric difference divided by union area.
boundaryMatch.matchInterpretation: Identical named coverage to numerical export precision; 0 strict-coordinate-identical geometries, all area differences below 0.000006%.
